title: Thinking it’s a shortcut to use AI for legal questions? You’re likely compromising your future.
description:
Attorney Nick Johnson emphasizes that trusting AI with your potential case is the fastest way to ensure you get nothing. A chatbot won’t stand up for you in court, but it can certainly talk you out of your rights.

Always get the professional representation you deserve.

Contact Osborne, Francis & Pettis at RealToughLawyers.com
